text:
meera: Heads-up — spotted oscillation on prod where automatic fallback flips between model-v1 and model-v1-quant for /generate. User requests get 500s sometimes and cost spikes in the same window. Anyone else seeing this?
sasha: Yup. Alerts came in. CB fired, then fallback toggled back immediately and we got another spike. Feels like no hysteresis / cooldown. :grimacing:
mike: Is this the same oscillation we saw in canary in Feb? IIRC policy cooldown was 0 there. Might be TTL config.
meera: Tenant defaults currently: `autoFallback: true`, `cooldownSeconds: 0`. We probably shouldn't have 0 as a sane default — need console UX to surface this and recommend safe defaults.
ryan: Agreed. Console should make `cooldownSeconds` and `hysteresisWindow` visible on the route page, and a tiny simulator to run synthetic traffic to preview behavior.
sasha: Telemetry piece: we should emit an `fallback.swap.count` metric (swaps per route) and a `fallback.swap.rate` (per minute). Show a sparkline on the route overview, and a small badge when swaps > threshold. Also link each swap to the audit log entry.
meera: Also propose an auto-suggest: set cooldown = max(latencyP95*2, 30s) by default, plus an opt-in `smartBackoff` that doubles cooldown on repeated swaps.
mike: API question: do we change semantics for existing `fallback` API or add a new flag `enableSmartBackoff`? We should avoid breaking clients.
ryan: Prefer adding `enableSmartBackoff` as opt-in. UX: toggle with tooltip "opt-in: platform may adjust cooldown during oscillations" and a small cost/latency simulation when you toggle.
deploy-bot: deploy:policy-svc v2.3.1 rolled to staging at 2147008300
sasha: Another UX idea: a temporary `quarantine` mode that, when oscillation detected, routes X% to a degraded variant (cached or shorter responses) to reduce churn and user-facing errors. Quick toggle in the banner.
meera: Runbook item — console should show actionable quick actions when oscillation > threshold: [Pin variant], [Force cooldown 300s], [Opt-in smartBackoff], and opening the runbook. Operator action must create an audit note and snapshot the current config.
ryan: Telemetry export: add button to download CSV of swaps, latencies, error rates for a chosen timeframe and links to spans/traces. That will speed RCA.
mike: I'll mock a top-of-page banner: "Oscillation detected — X swaps in Ym" with quick actions (pin, cooldown, smartBackoff, open runbook). Will post a screenshot in #design later.
meera: For alerting, tune thresholds: don't page on a single swap. Use >=3 swaps in 5m AND errorRateDelta > 1% AND cost spike > 20% as a starter rule.
sasha: :thumbsup:
